entities.summary: Asael Lubotzky is an Israeli physician, author, and molecular biologist. Formerly an officer in the Israel Defense Forces (IDF), he is a combat veteran of the Second Lebanon War. Asael Lubotzky was a physicians & medical pioneers from Efrat (b. 1983, Efrat). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
